content: Jiruwsalimaar yikir til jabiraar Pol warid.
Nyan dayak, “Gwur yara adakw,” wakuw, nyan ata wapabadiy jabirasaay. Wapakuw, Kas alib vivikatakaan yidiyan. Sira pik Ras walibab ril tamiyaar yikuw, ginyir Patara tamiyaam kawiydiyan.
Alim Paniysiya tamiyaar yikina jabir sitakirakuw, a jabiraar wulakuw, ata yidiyan.
Nyan yin Saypiris nibwuk vikuw, awkupw maka apika yidiyan Siriya tamiyaar. Taya tipaam kawiykuw, day a jabiraam ridiy niki jaav niki jaav kwurkuw, kawulaan kupwaam takadadiy.
Nyan nuwukadiy Kristen sitakirakuw, dayawa wik nak kwadiyan. God dikidi Mawul dayak simakakuw, day Polak wadiy, “Min Jiruwsalimaar yi maa.”
Dayawa kwabaal nyi kwusilik, ata yidiyan. Day abab, taakw nyanugwawa tip wapadaal nyanawa. Nabis ir yikuw, nyan abab kwatiyir sikuw, beten diyan.
Day, “Yara maay,” nyanak wadaak, aw nyan, “Yara adakw,” dayak wakuw, nyan jabiraar wulabaak, day ata sibinin yidiy dayadiy wiyaar.
Taya wapakuw, Talamayis tipaar ata yidiyan. Alim nyan Kristen gwalugwa duwak wayapiy sikuw, nyi nak dayawa kwadiyan.

Sira pik dayaam wapakuw, Sisariya tipaam kawiydiyan. Alim nyan Pilip diki wiyaar yikuw, diwa kwadiyan. Pilip di yin yaan tibagwud God diki maaj duw takwak wasapwiyik. Tayir Jiruwsalimaam nyan tasakwubaad nuwukadiy duw abwunawa day sugwiyaan kwurdakik Kristen duw takwak.
Pilip dikidiy takwa nyanugw aliy day duwak maa ri. Day God diki maaj wasapwiydiy.
Diwa nuwukadiy nyi kwakuw, God diki maaj wasapwiydi duw, dikidi si Akipwus, di Juwtiya tamiy wapakuw, Sisariyaar ata yad.

Di nyanak yakuw, Pol diki sipapuwtuw kwurkuw, di dikidiy manwa taab ata jididiy. Jikuw, di ata wadidiyan, “God dikidi Mawul ki maaj wadil, ‘Ki sipapuwtuw asaay duw adiy Jiruwsalimaam kwadiy duw atawa dim jikuw, niki jaka tipa kidiy duwak kwiykidanaad.’”
Nyan nuwukadiy duw takwawa diki maaj wukikuw, nyan Polak bas sidika sibaad di Jiruwsalimaar yi maardikik.

Aw di nyanak ata waad, “Agwa javik giranadiygwur? Gwur wuna mawul mwugiy-kigwura kapakap kapakap tilikikik. Wun Jiruwsalimaam kalabus ir wulaak kwulapwukuw, kwanadiwun. Wun Yitaypika Duw Jisas diki danik kiyakidiwun, wunabab alik kwulapwukuw, kwanadiwun.”
Nyan diki mawul warapiyik kwurbaal, aw maa rav. A jaav wukikuw, ata wadiyan, “Yaakiya, Yitaypika Duw dikidiy mawulaam rinadiy yawiy kwurkwaad.”
Jiruwsalimaam Pol maaj wadidiy Kristen sapakwa nyanugwak.
Nuwukadiy nyi alim kwakuw, nyanadiy jaav kwulapwukuw, ata yidiyan Jiruwsalimaar.
Nuwukadiy Sisariyaam kwadiy Kristen nyanawa yidiy. Day karay-dadiyan Masan diki wiyaar. Masan di Saypiris tipa kidi duwad. Aw di tayib Kristen tad. Diki mawul nyan dikiwa kwakinadiyan wakuw waal.
Nyan Jiruwsalimaar wakwukuw, a tipa kidiy Kristen gwalugwa duw rakarak tikuw, wayapiy sidadiyan.
Sira pik Pol nyanawa yad Jamis vikir. Abab a tipa God dikidi gwalugwa sapakwa nyanugw alim vagaluwdiy.
Pol dayak wayapiy sikuw, dayak wadidiy ababa yawiy God kwurdidiy dikik, nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw dayadiy nyidim tikuw.
Pol Kristen sapakwa nyanugw maaj wukikuw, God dikidi wiyaar yad.
Diki maaj wukikuw, day abab rakarak tidiy Godak. Day Polak ata wadaad, “Min wukimina Juw duwamiyir duwamiyir Jisasak wukijibir tikuw, day samasam wukinadiy nyanadi warag, Mawsis, diki lo-ak.

“Day bwu wukidaal min nuwukadiy tipaam kwanadiy Juwak kaliva-minidiy day Mawsis diki lo wapakwadiy. Day wakwanadiy min kaliva-minidiy day dayadiy nyanugw dayadiy sipaam kaam sakw maarkidana, Juw dayadiy sukw ab wapakwadiy.
“Adiy Juw wukikinadiy min bwutaay yanadimin. Agwa jaav kwurkidiyan?
“Ki wakibana jaav akwur. Kilim duw aliy kwanadiy. Day aban bwu takadaal Godak.

“Min dayawa yikuw, dayawa Mawsis diki lo wadil yawiy akwur gwur yara tigwurkikik. Minabab adiy duw jaav yapiykuw, day dayadiy nab sukwukwadiy. Atawa kwurkuw, ababa duw taakw wukikwadiy min Mawsis diki lo waam kwanadimin. Mina yawiy vikuw, day lakwu-kwadiy adiy wukidadiy maaj suwaal-adiy.

“Aw adiy nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy Kristenak maaj bwu wayakibaal. Dayak wabadiy day suwala god ak kwiydaal kwiyawa, nyikiyawa, adiy animal day kwaliyapaam kaybwuki-dadiy, adiy jaav kidaba. Duw takwaam vaal yidaba. Taakw duwaam vaal yidaba.”

Sira pik Pol adiy duw kwurkuw, dayawa Mawsis diki lo walil yawiy kwurid. Kwurkuw, God dikidi wiyaar wulakuw, dayadi wadidiy nyi kas yidaak, dayadiy Godak kwiydadiy animal dikik kwiykidadiy adiy pris viyasipadakik.
God dikidi wiyaam adiy Juw Polaam kalakwudaad.

Ginyir adiy nyi abitiy kwusik kwurdaak, nuwukadiy Asiya tamiyaam kwadiy Juw yakuw, day Polaam vidaad God dikidi wiyaam. Vikuw, day wadaak, ababa walibab tidiy duw taakw mawul warkuw, day Polaam kalakwudaad.

Day ata gaam sidiy, “Yisrayil duw, nyanak sugwiyaan akwur! Kidi duw ababa tipaam yin yaan tibagwukuw, Yisrayil duw takwak kalivadidiy day maa wakwadiy Mawsis diki lo wawa kidi God dikidi wiyak ab. Aw kita di nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw God dikidi wiyaar kwurin kariyadadiy. Atawa kwurdil, di watipidaal majim sarnaad.”
Aw tayir day Tirapimas, Yipisas tipa kidi duw vidaad Polawa Jiruwsalimaam. Alik day mawulaar wadiy Pol adi duw God dikidi wiyaar kwurin kariyadid.
Jiruwsalimaam duw taakw abab mawul jawjaay tikuw, day God dikidi wiyaar gipikuw, Polaam kalakwukuw, kwurin kalakwudaad kawaar. Jayib ni day God dikidi wiyaam tidiy wiyig takatipi-dadiy.
Rom dayadiy vay sawdiy duw Polaam nyigildaad.
Adiy duw Polaam viyasipak kwurdaak, Rom dayadiy vay sawdiy duw dayadi yitaypika duw di wukidil ababa Jiruwsalimaam kwadiy duw taakw day kip wariyadiy.
Di wukikuw, nuwukadiy vay sawdiy duw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugwawa kwurkuw, day gipidiy adiy wariyadiy duw takwak. Day adiy vay sawdiy duwaam vikuw, ata Polaam wapadaad.
Adiy vay sawdiy duw dayadi yitaypika duw Polaam kalakwukuw, di wadidiy day Polaam jidakikik sen vitiy kwurkuw. Di walibab tidiy duwak bas sididiy, “Kad sikadadaad? Di agwa jaav kwurnaad?”

Adiy vagaluwdiy duw taakw niki maaj niki majir gaam sidiy. Day abab jawjaay kwakuw, adi yitaypika duw di mwiyir maa laakw agwa jaava Pol kwurdil. Alik di vay sawdiy duwak wadidiy day Pol dayadi wiyaar kwurin karaydakik.
Pol daya wiy pitakawur warkuw, adiy Juw Polaam viyasipak kwurdaak, vay sawdiy duw Polaam kalakwukuw, kwurin karaydaad dayadiy sagwaam takakuw.
Adiy Juw Pol diki kwukir yakuw, nimadib gaam sidiy, “Dim aviyasupw!”
Adiy vay sawdiy duw Pol dayadi wiyaar karayik, Pol dayadi yitaypika duwak wadid, “Minak kwasa javik waaw?” Wadik, “Min Grik daya kwudiy lakwumina?” adi yitaypika duw Polak ata bas sidid.

“Wun wukituwa min adi Yijip jaka tipa kidi duw tayir di nyanawa wariyak tikuw, di wariya jaav karaydiy duw taakw kipa tamiyaar kwurin karaydidiy. Adiy duw taakw 4000 tidiy. Min adi duw-adimin? Ay maa?”
Pol ata wadid, “Wun Juw bapa duw-adiwun. Wun Silisiya tamiyaam rinadi tip Tasas tipa kid-adiwun. Ad nimadi tipad. Aw wun kidiy duw takwak maaj wakir.”
Adi yitaypika duw yaakiya wadik, Pol pitakawum rasin tikuw, taab ata takadil duw takwak. Day kaygan kwadaak, Pol ata wadidiy Yibiruw daya majir.
